# Sendforsign

> The contracts layer for products that build AI agents. An agent builds a contract from a template, fills in its own fields, lets each recipient fill theirs, sends it for e-signature and gets a webhook when it is signed. White-label and multi-tenant, with agent modes, send confirmations and an audit log. Simple electronic signatures for the EU and the US.

## Docs

- [AI agents](https://about.sendforsign.com/ai-agents/overview): MCP server quickstart (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code), headers, tools, modes and audit log
- [API introduction](https://about.sendforsign.com/api-reference/introapi): authentication with X-Sendforsign-Key, clientKey and userKey
- [Docs home](https://about.sendforsign.com/introduction)

## Endpoints

- REST API: https://api.sendforsign.com/api/
- MCP server (early access, Streamable HTTP): https://api.sendforsign.com/mcp
- App and API keys: https://app.sendforsign.com
